attchmntText: Newspaper Advertisement   Publication of Results   September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: DJ Mediaprint and Logistics Limited filed a notice regarding the publication of un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company published advertisements in the Financial Express and Pratahakal on November 15, 2026. Nivaka Fashions Limited announced that its Board of Directors approved the delisting of equity shares from the Metropolitan Stock Exchange of India Limited and the Calcutta Stock Exchange on November 14, 2026. The shares will remain listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange Limited. Sanmitra Commercial Limited filed its un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a net loss of 392.24 million rupees on a standalone basis and a net loss of 16.27 million rupees on a consolidated basis.

attchmntText: Dj Mediaprint & Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: DJ Mediaprint & Logistics Limited reported standalone financial results for Q2 FY27. Revenue from operations stood at Rs. 2,608.27 lakhs. EBITDA was Rs. 630.39 lakhs with a margin of 24.17 percent. Profit after tax was Rs. 246.15 lakhs. Earnings per share were Rs. 0.71. On a consolidated basis, revenue from operations was Rs. 3,184.41 lakhs. Consolidated EBITDA was Rs. 715.67 lakhs. Consolidated profit after tax was Rs. 273.63 lakhs. Consolidated EPS was Rs. 0.79. The company operates across printing, media, logistics, and digitization sectors. It serves banking, government, and corporate clients. The firm maintains over 18 active business clients and 5 lakh square feet of storage infrastructure.

attchmntText: Dj Mediaprint & Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'updates'.
voiceSummary: DJ Mediaprint & Logistics Limited reported standalone un-audited results for the half year ended 30th September 2026. Revenue from operations stood at Rs. 5,623.15 lakh, compared to Rs. 4,144.85 lakh in the corresponding previous period. Net profit for the half year was Rs. 433.44 lakh, up from Rs. 342.57 lakh previously. For the quarter ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 2,608.27 lakh, with a net profit of Rs. 246.15 lakh. Basic earnings per share were Rs. 1.257 for the half year and Rs. 0.710 for the quarter. The company converted 2,92,001 warrants into equity shares on 25th September 2026 at Rs. 114 per share. The Board of Directors approved the results on 13th November 2026. During September 2026, the DGGI conducted verification proceedings at the corporate office, but no tax demand has been issued.
